exercise_sessions_per_week.label: Exercise sessions per week
exercise_sessions_per_week.why: Possible bone and muscle risk: exercise is {delta} {unit} from the nearest limit. Act applies when it stays below 4 for two weeks.
exercise_sessions_per_week.action: Schedule more exercise sessions this week and tell the flight surgeon if it stays low.
exercise_sessions_per_week.howToMeasure: Count the exercise sessions you completed in the last 7 days from the exercise log.
exercise_sessions_per_week.whyItMatters: NASA found 6 to 7 sessions a week effective in spaceflight, against 2 to 3 a week to maintain bone on Earth.
exercise_sessions_per_week.source: NASA OCHMO-TB-030 (bone loss technical brief) for 6 to 7 sessions a week; the Watch and Act limits are design values

resting_heart_rate_bpm.label: Resting heart rate
resting_heart_rate_bpm.why: Resting heart rate is {delta} {unit} from your usual, more than 2 standard deviations. Watch applies when it lasts 3 days.
resting_heart_rate_bpm.action: Rest, re-measure, and tell the flight surgeon if it stays off for 3 days.
resting_heart_rate_bpm.howToMeasure: Sit quietly for a few minutes, then log your heart rate by hand entry.
resting_heart_rate_bpm.whyItMatters: A change from your own baseline can show cardiovascular adaptation to altered gravity.

standing_bp_drop.label: Blood pressure drop on standing
standing_bp_drop.why: A clear blood pressure drop on standing with dizziness is logged.
standing_bp_drop.action: Sit or lie down, drink fluids as planned, and tell the flight surgeon.
standing_bp_drop.howToMeasure: Measure blood pressure sitting, then standing. Enter 0 for no clear drop. Enter 1 for a clear drop with dizziness.
standing_bp_drop.whyItMatters: Orthostatic intolerance is the main cardiovascular risk during a mission.

orthostatic_symptoms.label: Orthostatic symptoms
orthostatic_symptoms.why: Possible orthostatic symptoms are logged (code {delta} from none).
orthostatic_symptoms.action: Sit or lie down. For fainting or chest pain, contact the flight surgeon now.
orthostatic_symptoms.howToMeasure: Enter 0 for none. Enter 1 for lightheaded on standing. Enter 2 for fainting or chest pain.
orthostatic_symptoms.whyItMatters: Fainting or chest pain needs attention from the flight surgeon at once.

low_intake_bone_note.label: Low food intake (bone note)
low_intake_bone_note.why: Low food intake is an extra reason for possible bone and muscle risk.
low_intake_bone_note.action: Raise this with the flight surgeon and review the planned menu.
low_intake_bone_note.howToMeasure: Fed from the nutrition module. Enter 0 when intake is on plan. Enter 1 when the nutrition module is in Watch or Act.
low_intake_bone_note.whyItMatters: NASA requires in-mission nutrient programs to provide 100% of calculated nutrient and energy requirements, which bone depends on.

bone_muscle_risk.why: Low exercise together with low food intake raises a possible bone and muscle risk. This is a risk level, not a measurement.
bone_muscle_risk.action: Review exercise and the menu with the flight surgeon. Do not start supplements on your own.
